verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a data-movement/ETL platform, not an AI agent that consumes tools; all MCP-related evidence describes Fivetran shipping an MCP *server* (fivetran-mcp) so other AI agents can query it, which is the opposite direction from 'plugging MCP servers into Fivetran so it can use their tools.' There is no evidence Fivetran itself acts as an MCP client consuming external tool servers, and this capability is not a natural fit for its product category.
